property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer requires that each low-level call to caddress succeeds (so calls to a callee that revert make transfer revert); the mutant inverts that check and therefore will accept failing callee calls and reject succeeding ones — deploying a callee that can be toggled to succeed or revert lets the fuzzer find inputs where behaviors diverge.
change_summary: Invert the success check after the external call so that the function requires the call to fail instead of succeed, causing different return behavior.
